notes.title: Pride Run - Major Update!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
I'm here to talk about our new major update.

You will now find in Pride Run:
1) NEW LEVEL: Pride Run comes to São Paulo!
2) NEW POWER-UPS: now you can find Power Up "Guest" during Play Hard matches.
3) NEW VANILLA MODE UI
4) NEW DANCE DUEL UI



São Paulo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/5f7cea85da6d0d21ce73fb7de078f38425bc07c1.png

Pride Run comes to South America!
São Paulo is the first additional level, but it's not the last one: Buenos Aires will be the next... and after that Pride will come to Asia!



Power Up Guests
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/c1193f1dd01f4fc518d17c392cac746ac53e6d22.png

During Play Hard matches you will be able to find new special power-ups that can unlock particolar kinds of leaders... that are real world artists!
Search in the streets of San Francisco, Madrid, Tokyo, Berlin, Instanbul, Pisa and Rome... you will find a great surprise!



Vanilla Mode UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/ad0843a88e05034949b70aa9735aba44ab96be2f.png

Due to popular demand we changed the vanilla viewer: from tre lines up to four.
Now each button has its own line and you are no longer going to confuse between left/right buttons.




Dance Duel UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/d5a9a8394f3f87ea093e3f8d153e9d676958fb46.png

We found out that a lot of players coulnd't find each button location during the Dance Duel. Now you can see every button with its position.


As always:
RUN PRIDE RUN!

notes.title: Pride Run - First Major Update
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Today we have uploaded our first major update, that contains:
- Free Artworks DLC (!!!)
- Multiple endings (4 new endings!)
- Japanese Language
- Fixed Vanilla Mode problem
- Added visual feedbacks for Multiplayer

In details:

Free Artworks DLC
Soon (this evening? tomorrow morning?) it will be available a free DLC with all the artworks made during the production of Pride Run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/47ceaf7be1f6401a4fd884a0874c15efc16226e0.gif




Multiple Endings
As some of you know, there were four different endings for Pride Run. Now they're doubled!
You can find 8 different versions of the finale, and we are going to publish more details about them next days (so stay tuned on steam hub!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/8d83345ab48803025b5ffc17ae4c467f67356777.gif




Added Japanese Language
Now you can play Pride Run also in Japanese!
(The other languagues in which the game is available are: english, german, italian, french, spanish and portoguese).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/0a7d5896d3834bdba73a0a210689bcde6b3d0150.png




Vanilla Mode Fix
As some users noticed: there was a small gap between the center of the button you had to press, and the rhytm of the music.
We fixed it: for some reason the game started a frame ahead with the visualization of the sequence.

For reference:  you have to press the button when the bar is in the center of the button in order to make a Pride Hit:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/4adc755cfcf7a40778f247ef4f8ae19a0edea12b.png

In this case I didn't hit the perfect center, but there's an offset on the left and right that permits the pride hit also if you're not in the correct millisecond (it will be unplayable otherwise).




Multiplayer Visual Feedback
We added an additional feedback for multiplayer Vanilla:
- If all the users play correctly, then a rainbow appears
- If some users make mistakes, the rainbow become more and more transparent (if all the players miss the hit, then no rainbow :( )

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/6a1192448f7de830610767e235f317eea209e891.gif



As always: Run Pride Run!

notes.title: Special Enemies
notes.content:
Hi there!
Today I'm here to talk about some obstacles you can find during play hard matches in Pride Run!

As you know, Pride Run features two game modes:
- Vanilla. A rhytm game where you have to push the right buttons during a song.
- Play Hard. A musical RTS where you have to attract people into the parade.

In this second mode you can sometime face SPECIAL ENEMIES:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/825cc094f4df048c1d9c60a306a13a1ed4f651b3.gif

They consist in special hurdles to overcome by pushing a series of buttons before it's too late: if you can push them correctly, they disappear.

Some examples of special enemies are:

- Rat
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/afb138112e04b294b8c4fcc7e65aa986b4ec077b.gif

- Godzilla
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/2bbf885732be0b5702ceb656e88f8da223d626e6.gif

- Tornado
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/807a003087cf78eb7688ebca21390f91204d03d0.gif

- Storm Bull
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/1d37ae5667d1b0113d81bab80d75529b07ea1bcd.gif

See you next time!

notes.title: Let us introduce ourselves! The PRIDE RUN team!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Here is Ivan Venturi, founder of IV Productions and Project Director of Pride Run!
Firstly, let me apologize for my rough english!

With a superbig pleasure, let me present you the team and in the meanwhile let me tell you a bit of the story of the development till now.

START
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/5621602f0c184631060761eb3ce02b6b60347cc5.jpg
The 11th of october 2016 I had the very first idea and a very rough picture of what the game could be, and I spoke with Giacomo Guccinelli about it. He was immediately hitten and immediately he told me "YES, let's do it!". Then, thanks to the president of the LGBTQ+ cultural centre of Bologna (the city where I live and where IV Productions is), we got in touch with Hard Ton, AKA Mauro.

So, the base was there! Under a production point of view, Pride Run has three pillars. One of us for every pillar:
- tech, design, gameplay, production: Ivan
- art: Giacomo
- music: Mauro
We started prototyping. I programmed a couple of prototypes in Game Maker to see if the mechanics we imagined were good to fit with the music. We found our way!

PRE-PRODUCTION
We began prototyping in Unity, while abandoning a first mechanics (a sort of initial game phase with the crowd movement through a tiled map) to enforce the other, called Street View.
Here the team in that moment (from left to right): Mauro, Davide, Max (in pixel art! Hard Ton singer), me, Giacomo, Katalin, Michele.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/7ffe369f0333d16eb30e4e336e5d8befc70ceca7.jpg
We produced a first playable version of the musical RTS game mode, now called PLAY HARD, and of the Dance Duel. We showed it in Lucca Comics & Games, just to understand what real players liked more or less. Moreover, we wanted to understand: how people will react to a game on the LGBTQ+ Prides?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/9f4858298aa8636a08ee869144b4dabae762528b.jpg
People loved it. We were there with a lot of friends and it was something like a party! But we discovered also that the RTS gameplay, as we implemented, was not in the right direction.
So, we threw away everything and we began to code from scratch.

Me, Giacomo and Mauro funded the project by ourselves and we produced the two game modes, this time working well, and 4 scenarios, even if not complete as they are now in the game. Anyway, it was enough to go to Paris to the Game Connection looking for a publisher.
Here, we met Jonny of Green Man Gaming!
Overally, the game had a huge success with publishers, everyone was interested and even we won two prizes. But we were looking to a specific publisher. One that would be able (and having the will) to deal with the unovoidable issues from haters and toxic people in the videogame market.
Just one thing: One Man Gaming changes its logo in a rainbow version for the Pride season. And more. To cut the long story short, we understood that GMG was our perfect publisher. The needed extension of our team.
We signed!

PRODUCTION
We started the production, with additional collaborators working on graphics, musics, FX, data structures etc.
Here a picture we took with David, director of Green Man Gaming Publishing, who came in Bologna (after a supergreat lunch of tortellini in brodo).
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/dd29cb5f880be700b372b6dd7bd6ba29c6bb9fc8.jpg
From left to right: Kyle, Davide, Michele, Luisa Maria, David, Marianna, Daniele, Giacomo, Massimo, me. Mauro is not in the picture as after lunch had to go somewhere. Moreover, we need to add Simone, Paride, Elena, Ilaria, who are not in the picture.

We can really say that we are a diverse team, under a LGBTQ+ point of view. We have all the colors of the rainbow in our team!

NOW
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/057e10208f59f9040ea3df8f0795b5fe4f1ac970.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/8a26cf273be2e99dbc67f8b6c089986d13c8c98c.jpg

These pictures were taken some day ago, while the team was trying the Vanilla mode with the Dance Pad, where you push buttons with your feet. (btw: FANTASTIC!).

We are working hard to give you the best game as possible, for this autumn!
I'll keep you updated as I can, giving you a lot of info, but without doing too much spoiler about the game. We want you to be 200% surprised the first time you'll play the game!

Talk soon, and RUN PRIDE RUN!
